period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior 31-December audited position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year (for Q1, cumulative = discrete, the filing shows only one 3-month column), as published in the bank's own unaudited 'Balance Sheet' and 'Profit and Loss Account' for the quarter ended 31 March 2016. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank Limited' with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier -- note the same source PDF also contains a CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet earlier in the document headed 'Mercantile Bank Limited and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). Fully manually cross-checked against every internal subtotal: balance-sheet identity (Total Property and Assets 189,955,258,976 = sum of the 7 asset lines, ties exactly; Total Liabilities 173,877,900,700 = Borrowings + Deposits and other accounts + Subordinated bond + Other Liabilities, ties exactly; Total shareholders' equity 16,077,358,276 = Paid-up capital + Statutory reserve + Other reserve + Surplus in P&L, ties exactly; Total Liabilities + Equity = Total Assets exactly, both for the Mar-16 and the Dec-15 comparative column), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income, ties exactly), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain (Total operating expenses = sum of its 10 component lines exactly; Profit before provision = Total operating income - Total operating expenses exactly; Total provision, Total profit before taxes, tax, and Net profit after taxation all tie exactly), the appropriation chain (Net profit + Retained surplus b/f = Statutory reserve appropriation + Retained earnings, ties exactly and the Retained earnings figure matches the Balance Sheet's own 'Surplus in profit & loss account' line exactly), and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value) = 0.581, matches the reported 0.58; prior-year Mar-15 EPS of 0.02 also ties to its own net profit of 16,363,828 on the same share count). The Dec-15 comparative column was independently cross-checked against this dataset's already-stored quarterly/2015_Q4.json: total_assets (189,955,258,976 vs no direct Q1-2016 equivalent needed -- the DEC-15 column itself), paid_up_capital (7,391.57m), total_equity (15,513.73m), total_liabilities (167,286.44m), total_assets (182,800.17m) and gross_loans (126,338.83m) all match the stored 2015_Q4.json figures exactly. (Note: this filing's Dec-15 'Deposits and other accounts' balance-sheet line of 147,816.28m does not match 2015_Q4.json's stored total_deposits of 154,869.52m; since every other cross-check -- including the more fundamental total_liabilities and total_assets identities -- ties out exactly, this is treated as a pre-existing definitional difference in the annual Five-Year summary table's 'deposits' figure, e.g. a broader deposit-base definition, not an error in either document, and is left unresolved rather than guessed at.) Zero other discrepancies found anywhere in this document. Source was a single combined PDF containing Balance Sheet, Off-Balance-Sheet items, Profit and Loss Account, and Cash Flow Statement together (the format mblbd.com used from around 2014 onward, unlike the separate single-statement PDFs of 2011-2013).
